13303.headline: Rookie debuts in relief; may start Week 11 at Chargers
13303.news: Klubnik, a fourth-round rookie from Clemson, made his NFL debut on Nov. 15 against Buffalo after Geno Smith was hurt. Reports differ on the details: Smith was evaluated for a concussion after a hard hit before halftime, and he was later ruled out with an ankle injury and sent for X-rays. Per Sleeper, Klubnik went 11-of-20 for 137 yards and an interception and ran 3 times for 26 yards (7.1 half-PPR) on 37 of 71 snaps. The Jets said Smith's status for the Week 11 game at the Chargers will be decided during the week.
13303.take: Even if he starts, a rookie making his first start on the road against the Chargers is a tough spot, and 6.9 yards per attempt with a pick is a modest debut. He's not a redraft start in 12-team 1QB leagues. In superflex dynasty, a rebuilding team should take a cheap flier: any extended starts this season give a real look at whether he can be a long-term QB2. Don't pay more than a late pick until he shows more.
